name: Jesus Ruling In Jerusalem
overview: Scripture reveals that Jerusalem holds a unique and divine significance as the throne of the LORD, where all nations will be gathered in reverence, abandoning their former stubbornness and evil imaginations (Jeremiah 3:17). The prophetic anticipation of the day of the LORD includes both judgment and restoration, as seen in Zechariah's warning of coming upheaval (Zechariah 14:1) and Jesus’ own foretelling of His glorious return to the temple and the world (Matthew 24:1, 24:30). This culminates in the establishment of Christ’s righteous rule, a reality inaugurated through the Spirit’s power at Pentecost (Acts 2:1), affirming God’s sovereign reign centered in Jerusalem and fulfilled in Jesus Christ.
